PROFILE-lyn local editor

Open index.html in a normal web browser. Keep this entire editor folder together,
including the icons folder and every JavaScript/CSS file. No website hosting,
account, extra port or Internet connection is needed to edit the menu.

The mod creates this folder automatically when the server starts. Run
/profile editor as an operator to refresh its copy of the current server layout.
On a hosted server, download config/profile-lyn/profile-editor.zip to your PC,
extract it, and open editor/index.html. You can also download the entire editor
folder instead. Downloading index.html alone is not enough.

After editing, choose Export to server > Copy import command. Run the command in
Minecraft chat as an operator, or paste it into the server console WITHOUT its
leading /. You can also download profile.json, upload it to
config/profile-lyn/profile.json and run /profile reload.

Editing the browser preview alone does not change the running server.
ECO-API-lyn is optional and only needs to be installed on the server for balances.
